Additions: Id: lesson_specific_zuzu_carrot_sharing
Scope: story
Title: <PERSON> Actively Shares Her Prized Carrot
Plain: <PERSON> shares her favorite carrot or snack with a friend instead of keeping it all to herself.
Rubric: Review the full story text. <PERSON> must willingly offer a piece or portion of her carrot (or harvest) to another character who is in need or wanting some. A violation occurs if <PERSON> eats the entire carrot alone, refuses to share, or only shares under adult coercion rather than her own cheerful choice.
Repair Hint: Have <PERSON> notice a friend looking hungry or sad and warmly offer to break her carrot in half to share.
Id: lesson_specific_mutual_happiness_outcome
Scope: story
Title: Sharing Brings Joy to Both <PERSON> and Her Friend
Plain: The story clearly shows that sharing makes both <PERSON> and the receiver happier.
Rubric: Check the resolution of the story. The act of sharing must explicitly depict both <PERSON> and the other character smiling, celebrating, or expressing joy together as a direct result of sharing. A violation occurs if <PERSON> regrets sharing, feels sad about having less, or if the recipient does not appreciate the gesture.
Repair Hint: Describe both characters smiling with happy curved eyes, enjoying their snack and company together.
